specs: For safety reasons, there is a weight limit of 250 pounds per person.
Children 8 years old and up may ride on the boat with an adult.
Life preservers must be worn for all children 8 years old to 15 years old.
The driver must be under the legal limit for alcohol to navigate the boat.
If a driver appears to be under the influence of alcohol, we have the right to refuse service to them.
2 people must be in each boat that goes out on the tour (excluding the guide boat).
You must be 18 years old with a valid driver’s license to operate the boat, you must provide driver's license during check in.

blurb: If you’re looking for things to do in Mystic, get ready to be amazed! On our 3-hour Mystic, CT boat tours, you can get an up-close and personal view of historic landmarks, including the Mystic Drawbridge and Mystic Seaport. As we head back down into open water, we let it rip and catch breathtaking views of the Fishers Island Sound, local lighthouses, and CT, NY, and RI waterways.

quotes.text: We took the 3-hour sunset tour over Labor Day weekend. We could not have asked for better weather. We went up the Mystic River and had a great view of Mystic Seaport and Mystic Village. Our perspective of these places from the water is really unique. Toward the end Bobby took the group out near an island in the ocean to watch the sunset and take some pics. It was a beautiful sight. I would highly recommend this to anyone looking for something unique and adventurous to do.

Rob is incredible, informative and patient. Showed us all the history of Mystic. We were lucky to be the only couple with him in the am, the weather was cold and cloudy but thanks to Rob it was still an amazing adventure. The boats are a ton of fun and easy to drive. He tells you everything you need to know. I can't thank him enough for his guidance and hospitality!!! I highly recommend doing this whether your tame or wild it's great for all!!!

Awesome adventure. So much fun! Skipper is one crazy guy. Had us ducking under the Mystic Bridge and cruising by historic ships in the harbor, But nothing beat doing figure 8's and donuts, and bouncing across the waves at full throttle. We all had such a wild time that skipper lost track of how long we were out and gave us an extra half hour! Will be going back with friends and family!

We did the 3-hour sunset cruise and it was amazing. Relaxing and gorgeous sprinkled with local information it all combined to be a really phenomenal way to spend our day! Our guide was great, super informative and fun! One would have to be insane to feel unsafe on these boats. They handle well, are delightful and unflippable. I will one hundred percent be back!

We had a great time. Arthur and Bob were professional, knowledgeable, joyful and very attentive to safety. They went above and beyond to make sure that my family and I had a great time. We strongly recommend this boat excursion. It balances sightseeing and relaxation with high energy activity and fun. We will definitely be doing this again!

This was so much fun and Rob the owner and guide could not have been nicer or more helpful we had the best time. This is a great way to see mystic because you are actually driving the boat and having a great time. Would recommend this to anyone who plans a trip to Mystic will definitely be coming back and referring my family and friends!
